concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-credit-card-verification-search-node]] - Node.js credit-card-verification search by verification, customer, card, payment-method, billing-address or creation-time criteria, with callback iteration, qualified timezone behavior and a preserved policy-based result-limitation notice
warnings: Keep this route scoped to credit-card-verification searches; its criteria and returned verification examples do not establish transaction-search or customer-search behavior.
Preserve the PayPal Data Protection Addendum notice without interpreting the unread external policy or inventing a numeric result cap, affected fields or restriction rationale.

Do not import generic stream, callback, maximum-count or search-cap semantics from the separate Search results page; this source directly establishes only its displayed callback `response.each()` example and assigns other example calls to `stream` without demonstrating consumption.
Keep the created-at timezone qualification intact: supplied timezone respected, gateway-account timezone used when absent, and returned time values in UTC.
